cobblemon.species.averi.name: Averi
cobblemon.species.averi.desc1: This Pokémon is frequently seen assisting Meowscarada with magic tricks. It is happy to help, as long as it's not eaten.
cobblemon.species.averi.desc2: Trainers appear to be happier when nearby this Pokémon. Some theorise it has an aura of happiness, others think it's very cute.
cobblemon.species.averon.name: Averon
cobblemon.species.averon.desc1: Having grown in size from Averi, this Pokémon is now able to defend other Pokémon, assist in transportation and provide better hugs.
cobblemon.species.averon.desc2: The ball above its head grows if nearby trainers or Pokémon are happy. This Pokémon was already kind, but now always aims to improve the lives of those around it
cobblemon.species.averist.name: Averist
cobblemon.species.averist.desc1: This Pokémon absorbed energy from its kind acts, providing it new power. It continues to help people, despite not gaining more power.
cobblemon.species.averist.desc2: This Pokémon can use its psychic abilities to share ideas with humans. It's commonly seen near Absol, guiding those in danger
cobblemon.species.baitellapup.name: Baitellapup
cobblemon.species.lupsostrial.name: Lupsostrial
cobblemon.species.selcanirave.name: Selcanirave
cobblemon.species.ryuka.name: Ryuka
cobblemon.species.ryuka.desc: This prototype defence unit was designed by chance. Using DNA of a previously unknown fossil Pokémon jump started its activation in unexpected ways.
cobblemon.species.rymodel.name: Rymodel
cobblemon.species.rymodel.desc: This remodel become intent in picking fights that should not be won from by its programming alone. One unit had picked a fight against a Sandslash, roaring monstrously as the Sandslash fled.
cobblemon.species.ryunit.name: Ryunit
cobblemon.species.ryunit.desc: The finalized version of this anti Pokémon defense unit, due to a fatal flaw in its programming once its energy depletes the fossil reawakens, becoming a rampaging beast that can cause more destruction than an enraged Gyarados.
cobblemon.species.budjolt.name: Budjolt
cobblemon.species.budjolt.desc: To protect itself from predators, it flies in massive flocks that generate tremendous electrical charges. It's sociable but mischievous.
cobblemon.species.shockatiel.name: Shockatiel
cobblemon.species.shockatiel.desc: The bright crest on its head gathers and stores ambient electricity that it discharges at will. It delights in loud noises and will often loudly taunt larger Pokémon.
cobblemon.species.raucatoo.name: Raucatoo
cobblemon.species.raucatoo.desc: Its voice booms like thunder, and with the flashing of its electrified crest this Pokémon's presence is impossible to ignore. While it is rebellious by nature, a patient Trainer may find its attention-seeking antics endearing.
cobblemon.species.crepitule.name: Crepitule
cobblemon.species.crepitule.desc: Crepitule's flames are created by two chemicals stored in its abdomen, despite the quantity produced it rarely ignites.
cobblemon.species.flammentle.name: Flammentle
cobblemon.species.flammentle.desc: Frustrated by the weakness of their firepower, Flammentles often take out their anger on weaker Pokémon and stand up to their trainers.
cobblemon.species.blazeufel.name: Blazeufel
cobblemon.species.blazeufel.desc: Upon evolving, Blazeufel's chemical makeup becomes poisonous and highly flammable. They often coat themselves and their territory with it to enhance their fire attacks.
cobblemon.species.geomite.name: Geomite
cobblemon.species.geomite.desc: A small skittish Pokémon, that grows faceted, gem-like clusters on its back. When frightened, it tucks its legs beneath its rocky shell to disguise itself as an ordinary, immovable pebble.
cobblemon.species.arachnolith.name: Arachnolith
cobblemon.species.arachnolith.desc: As a patient ambush predator, it spins intricate, near-invisible silk traps across narrow pathways. It lies perfectly motionless in the shadows, waiting to strike the moment unsuspecting prey becomes ensnared.
cobblemon.species.terrachne.name: Terrachne
cobblemon.species.terrachne.desc: Layers of natural stone cover Terrachne's body, forming an armor-like shell that grows throughout its life. Once prey is trapped in its webs, it uses its enormous crystal-tipped armored forelimbs to crush and impale its victims with overwhelming force.
cobblemon.move.absolutesalvo.desc: The user fires all of its electrically charged Energy in a full-power barrage. After attacking, the user loses its Electric type and hits again, dealing physical damage.
cobblemon.move.boulderbash.desc: The user tackles the target with its rocky body.
cobblemon.move.featherbarrage.desc: The user flaps a wing to release feathers, then launches 3 feathers at the opposing Pokémon
cobblemon.move.crystallinesnare.desc: User attacks the opposing Pokémon with webs and lowers the target's Defense and Sp. Def every turn.
cobblemon.battle.activate.crystallinesna: %1$s has been trapped in crystal embedded webs.
cobblemon.battle.damage.crystallinesnare: %1$s took damage from the crystal shards.
cobblemon.move.exhaust.desc: The user retreats using its exhaust. This may burn the opponent.
cobblemon.move.skywardstrike.desc: The user sends the opponent flying while taking off.
cobblemon.move.updraft.desc: The user uses the wind to quickly retreat while slowing down the opponent.
cobblemon.ability.backunit.desc: If the Pokémon has electric type it will have levitate. Once it loses its electric type, its physical and special stats will be swapped and it loses levitation.
cobblemon.ability.chemical.desc: The Pokémon's fire attacks are powered by a poisonous chemical, they may leave the target poisoned.
cobblemon.ability.secondwind.desc: This Pokémon sets Tailwind for a short duration when withdrawn from battle.
